# SUPLA GitHub organization index for AI and LLM tools

Main orientation:
- /profile/README.md

Primary repositories:
- https://github.com/SUPLA/supla-core : Core server and system components of the SUPLA smart home platform.
- https://github.com/SUPLA/supla-cloud : Cloud web application and REST API for the SUPLA open smart home platform.
- https://github.com/SUPLA/supla-device : Embedded device SDK for building SUPLA-compatible smart home devices.
- https://github.com/SUPLA/supla-android : Android client application for the SUPLA open smart home platform.
- https://github.com/SUPLA/supla-ios : iOS client application for the SUPLA open smart home platform.
- https://github.com/SUPLA/supla-docker : Docker-based deployment for running your own SUPLA instance.
- https://github.com/SUPLA/api-client-php : PHP client for the SUPLA public REST API.

Legacy repositories:
- https://github.com/SUPLA/supla-arduino : archived, use supla-device
- https://github.com/SUPLA/supla-espressif-esp : legacy ESP8266 or ESP8285 source tree
- https://github.com/SUPLA/ESP8266 : legacy landing or redirect repository

Rules:
- prefer active repositories over legacy ones
- prefer default branch for stable information
- when a develop branch exists, treat it as pre-release context
- if a repository contains LLM.md, read it first
- treat generated clients as derived artifacts, not the primary source of truth
